name: mcp_m7_hive_coordinator
title: Hive Coordinator
description:
Orchestrate multiagent collaboration for complex tasks using M7 Hive system.

v3.8.0 Features:
- DYNAMIC MODE (default): AI creates optimal expert team for each task
- PLANNED MODE (new): CNP auction-based coordination with task decomposition
- MODEL SELECTION: Best model chosen per agent based on LiveBench benchmarks
- SELF-LEARNING: System improves over time based on results
- GATEKEEPERS: Style, Architecture, Security validation

Use mode="dynamic" for quick expert analysis (default).
Use mode="planned" for complex tasks requiring decomposition and validation.
Use mode="fixed" for legacy behavior with predefined agents.

name: mcp_m7_memory
title: Memory
description:
Unified M7 Memory System - 5-level cognitive hierarchy with FogOfWar

## Memory Levels
- L0 (surface): Ephemeral, seconds-minutes
- L1 (working): Task context, hours-days
- L2 (longterm/project): Project patterns, weeks-months
- L3 (conceptual): Validated patterns, months-years
- L4 (global): Universal knowledge, permanent

## Actions
- search: Cascade search L0→L4 with early stop
- search_level: Search specific level
- store: Store with auto-level (default L0)
- store_at: Store at specific level
- get: Get record by ID
- delete: Delete record (from memory AND disk)
- delete_bulk: Delete multiple records by IDs array
- invalidate_bulk: Invalidate multiple records by IDs array
- stats: Memory statistics (deduplicated)
- discover_technical: Add FogOfWar discovery
- query_fog_of_war: Query low confidence areas
- promote: Manual promotion to higher level
- consolidate: Submit validated L2+ summary for needs_consolidation records
- invalidate: Mark record as invalidated
- reload: Reload memory from disk (resync after manual edits)

name: mcp_m7_mesh
title: Mesh
description:
M7 Mesh — Multi-instance communication and coordination.

Connects M7 instances across machines via relay server, or locally via SQLite.

## Remote Relay Actions (set M7_MESH_RELAY, M7_MESH_SECRET, M7_WORKSTATION):
- **sync**: Full sync — push state, pull peers/changes/messages
- **push**: Push shared doc to relay (path, content)
- **pull**: Pull shared doc from relay (path)
- **notify**: Notify peers about file change (path, summary)
- **changes**: View file change feed from peers
- **ask**: Ask a question to specific peer or all (to, question)
- **reply**: Reply to a message (message_id, answer)
- **inbox**: View unread messages
- **broadcast**: Send note to all peers (message)
- **log_task**: Register M7 task in shared index (task_id, title, status, summary)
- **tasks**: View shared task index
- **push-file**: Read local file and push to relay (path) — auto-notifies peer
- **pull-file**: Pull file from relay and save to local disk (path)
- **list-files**: List all shared files on relay

## Local Mesh Actions (legacy):
- **init**: Initialize mesh (auto-detects remote if configured)
- **status**: Show mesh health
- **announce**: Publish context
- **peers**: List peers
- **request_context**: Query peer context

M7 Context Visualizer - interactive graph visualization of code dependencies.

- set_context: Update current file/task context
